0.16.0: Cursor magic: turn it on here, and a long job ends with her sending magic to your pointer.
She waits until you are back, and stays quiet while you are looking at her session. Try it: /mascot magic.
0.15.1: She stays on top: when Windows lets a window slip above her, she is back in front within a second.
0.15.0: Updates: an Updates card here, /mascot update, and a banner for each new version.
Install from the marketplace: /plugin marketplace add desuqcafe/cc-mascot.
